clips.title: The story
paras: Waters gather behind Stonewrought Dam along Loch Modan’s northern rim. The dwarven barrier holds back the Loch and drains the Wetlands below into habitable marshes.

Stonewrought Dam stretches across the canyon east of Dun Algaz, one of the great works of dwarven craft. Dark Iron architect Franclorn Forgewright designed it and pioneered the stonewrought technique used to build it. By trapping water in the mountain basin, the dam doubled the Loch’s surface area and steadily lowered the waters to the north. The Wetlands emerged from a valley once completely flooded.

Stonewrought Dam now serves Ironforge, though Dark Iron saboteurs from the southern mountains target it. After recent assaults and attempts to infiltrate the dam, Ironforge placed a garrison here under Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII. Guards and engineers patrol the masonry day and night. A breach could drain the Loch and unleash a devastating flood across the Wetlands below.
